subject: Data Structures
title: Discover Stacks
description: Discover how a Stack stores and removes data.

mission.title: Discover LIFO
mission.description: Find the hidden rule behind a Stack.

quiz.question: Which block was removed from the Stack?

discovery.title: Last In First Out
discovery.summary: The last item pushed onto a Stack is the first item removed.

sections.title: What is a Stack?
sections.content: A Stack is a linear data structure where the last element added is the first element removed.

sections.title: LIFO
sections.content: LIFO means Last In, First Out.

sections.title: Operations
sections.content: PUSH adds an element to the top. POP removes the top element.

sections.title: Real-world example
sections.content: A stack of plates follows the same rule. Plates are added and removed from the top.

alternate_explanations.title: Think of plates
alternate_explanations.content: A Stack works like plates placed on top of each other. The last plate added is the first one removed.

alternate_explanations.title: Walk through it
alternate_explanations.content: PUSH 10, then 20, then 30. POP removes 30 first because it is on top.

introduction.title: Meet the Stack
introduction.content: A Stack holds items in a vertical pile. You will experiment with adding items and taking them away.
points: Items are added at the TOP.
Items are removed from the TOP.
You are about to use PUSH and POP.

worked_example.title: Watch PUSH and POP
worked_example.content: Follow the stack as each operation changes the top item.

steps.explanation: 10 is the first item, so it becomes the top.
30 is now sitting at the top.
POP removes the item at the top.

worked_example.conclusion: 30 disappeared because it was the most recently added item and was sitting at the top.

next.title: Use the playground below.
next.content: Try PUSH to add blocks, then POP to remove the top block.

push: You pushed {value}. Notice that it entered at the TOP of the Stack.
{value} was placed above 10. New items always enter from the TOP.
{value} is now the TOP item because it was added last.
action_explanations.pop: {removed} was removed because POP removes the item currently at the TOP.

prediction.pending_message: Choose a prediction, then press POP to check it.

challenge.title: Stack Challenge
challenge.start_message: You completed the guided mission. Now apply the rule yourself.
challenge.continue_message: Challenge complete. Keep experimenting with the Stack whenever you want.

phases.title: Build this Stack
phases.instruction: Use the playground to make the target.
phases.feedback: Look at the target Stack and compare it with yours.

phases.title: Now remove the TOP item.
phases.instruction: Make the Stack match this new target.
phases.feedback: Look at the target Stack and compare it with yours.

recall.title: Recall
recall.prompt: In your own words, why does POP remove the most recently added item?
recall.empty_message: Write a short explanation before submitting.
recall.model_answer: POP removes the top item. Since new items are pushed onto the top, the most recently added item is removed first.

guidance.start_message: Build the target Stack using the rules you learned. The target shows the final order, not the buttons to press.

items.content: Read the target from bottom to top to decide which items must be added first.

phases.title: Build the target Stack
phases.instruction: Make your Stack match the target. Decide how items need to be ordered.
phases.feedback: Compare the target with your Stack and think about which item belongs at the top.

guidance.start_message: Transform the starting Stack into the target. Choose the operations yourself.

items.content: Compare the two Stacks from the TOP down. Only the top item can be removed or replaced.

phases.title: Transform the Stack
phases.instruction: The playground shows the starting Stack. Transform it until it matches this target.
phases.feedback: The middle and bottom already match. Focus on what must change at the top.

guidance.start_message: Reach the target before the operation limit runs out. Plan from the top of the Stack.

items.content: Count how many top items differ before you begin adding the new target items.

phases.title: Solve within four operations
phases.instruction: Transform the starting Stack into the target in no more than four operations.
phases.feedback: The operation limit is tight. Think about which existing items must leave before new ones can be added.

constraints.operation_limit_message: Operation limit reached. Target not achieved. Retry Solve with a shorter plan.

guidance.start_message: This is an unfamiliar Stack transformation. No hints are available; choose the strategy and stay within the limit.

phases.title: Master the transformation
phases.instruction: Transform the starting Stack into the unfamiliar target using no more than four operations.
phases.feedback: Compare the target and current Stack from the top; only top items can change.

constraints.operation_limit_message: Operation limit reached. Target not achieved. Retry Mastery with a more efficient plan.

thinking.title: Think before you run it
thinking.start_message: First simulate the Stack in your head. The sequence will animate only after you commit to a prediction.
thinking.instruction: Study the starting Stack and operations before you make a prediction.
thinking.do_not_execute: Do not perform these operations yet. Work through them in your head.
thinking.final_state_prompt: After all operations are completed, what will the Stack contain?
thinking.next_pop_prompt: What value would the NEXT POP remove?
thinking.replay_message: Now watch the Stack carry out the sequence.
thinking.actual_result: Final Stack, from TOP to bottom: {{final_state}}. The next POP would remove {{next_pop}}.

feedback.all_correct: Excellent mental simulation. Both predictions match the Stack.
feedback.final_state_correct: Your final Stack is correct. Notice which value is now on TOP.
feedback.next_pop_correct: You identified the next POP correctly. Compare the rest of the final Stack with the replay.
feedback.incorrect: Compare the replay one operation at a time. PUSH adds to TOP and POP removes only the current TOP item.

solve.title: Expert Challenge
solve.start_message: Transform START into TARGET. There are no hints and the optimal operation count is hidden until you solve it.
solve.instruction: Transform START into TARGET using the available PUSH values. Plan before you act; the minimum operation count stays hidden until you reach the target.
solve.operation_rule: Every selected PUSH and POP counts as one operation.
solve.feedback: Keep comparing the two Stacks from the bottom upward. Only the current TOP can be removed.
solve.solved_result: Your solution: {{operations}} operations. Optimal solution: {{optimal_operations}} operations.
solve.perfect_result: Solved in the minimum possible operations: {{optimal_operations}}.
